title: Optimizing Entity Recognition in Psychiatric Treatment Data with Large Language Models
details: SMB Hosseini, MJM Nezhad, M Hosseini, M Zolnoori - Studies in health technology …, 2025
abstract: Extracting nuanced adverse drug reactions (ADRs) from patient self-reported messages using is pivotal but challenging, particularly given HIPAA constraints. We investigate locally deployable small LLMs-Mistral-7B, Llama-3-8B, and Gemma-7B …
